items.q: The father was the leader. James Irwin was a piano player, Dorchester Irwin was a guitar player and Harris Irwin was one of the best baritone saxophone players I ever heard.

ctx.x: Oh, it was a small band?
Yes. The father was the leader. James Irwin was a piano player, Dorchester Irwin was a guitar player and Harris Irwin was one of the best baritone saxophone players I ever heard.
